name: HyperLean
storyline:
In a world where speed is the only language left, the HyperLean circuits cut through neon-lit cities, mountain passes and storm-swept coastlines. You are a rookie rider on a light, twitchy machine, with one gift: you can feel the lean.

Every corner is a negotiation between gravity and nerve. Tip in too little and the apex slips away. Tip in too far and the asphalt collects. Race by race, you earn your medals, shave milliseconds off your best laps and unlock tougher circuits where only precise riders survive.

You’re never riding alone. The ghosts of the world’s fastest pilots wait on every leaderboard, tracing the perfect line. Beat the time above you, climb the ranks, and one day the ghost everyone else chases will be yours.

Lean in. Let go. Chase the record.
summary:
Lean in. Own the line.

HyperLean is a sci-fi neon superbike racing game about one thing: the feeling of a motorcycle at the edge of grip. Brake upright. Turn in late. Hold the lean. Roll the throttle on and let the exit open up.

Nineteen original circuits, from a sunset ring of light to a clockwork city, a molten foundry, a buried machine and a grand prix at night in the City of Light. Five superbikes, each with its own engine, its own howl and its own temper. One clock, one ghost of your best lap, and a rival who wants the racing line as badly as you do.
